$comment: Policy for scripts/ci/gate.mjs, the final ci-gate job of .github/workflows/validate.yml (docs/ci-cd.md). Every job listed in required must appear in ci-gate's needs and succeed. A job may be skipped only where allowedSkips names it, for the listed events, and only when the named output of another job says so. evidence refuses a green run that validated nothing. Weakening this file weakens the merge gate: change it only in a reviewed PR.

isolation.reason: the pull request does not touch project execution, CI scripts, workflows or the package manifest

validate.reason: the full suite ran (519 tests on 2026-11-05; lower this only in a reviewed PR that removes tests)
